topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon a piece of paper tucked away in a corner of our shared drawer, a list of aspirations in familiar handwriting. Each item, from 'Visit the Northern Lights' to 'Learn to play the guitar,' whispered of my partner's dreams I hadn’t known about. I felt a weight as I wondered why these wishes were kept hidden, why they weren’t a part of our conversations. I decided to bring this list to our next quiet evening, hoping to share in the excitement of these goals, to show that I want to be a part of them, to support and maybe even surprise with a step towards one of these dreams. It’s the little moments we build our life together that matter, after all.
